critical_code_review_comments: BgpPeerManager.tsx is now ~690 lines — right at the 700-line ceiling. Split the Push modal (config/diff/apply flow) and Add/Edit modal into sub-components for maintainability before next iteration.

Dashboard root shows an SSR hydration mismatch on 'Since:' timestamp titles (server uses 'YYYY-MM-DD h:mm:ss' vs client locale 'M/D/YYYY, h:mm:ss'). Not breaking, but visible in console as a React hydration error. Format the timestamp deterministically (e.g., UTC ISO or a fixed formatter) or wrap in `suppressHydrationWarning`.
webpack-hmr WebSocket returns 502 through the ingress in preview (dev-only, harmless but noisy in console).
push route.ts: 'lastPushLog' is stored on failure but not exposed on the row UI — could be surfaced via a tooltip on the 'Push failed' badge so operators can debug without reopening the modal.

success_rate.backend: not directly tested via pytest (exercised end-to-end through UI + real SSH; /api/bgp-peers/push preview+diff+apply all 200 OK)
